# Titan Professions Multi

Titan Professions Multi is a collection of Titan Panel plugins for tracking profession skill levels, session progress, reagents, and archaeology fragments across multiple versions of World of Warcraft.

Titan Panel is required.

![Titan Professions Multi menu](https://i.imgur.com/M6B4WGq.jpg)

![Profession plugins on the Titan bar](https://i.imgur.com/zgP7iIN.jpg)

## Features

- Individual Titan plugins for every profession available in the current game client.
- A **Master** plugin that summarizes all learned professions in one tooltip.
- Current and maximum profession skill values, active skill bonuses, and gains made during the current session.
- Left-click access to profession windows when supported by the game client.
- Optional profession-combination suggestions in tooltips.
- Reagent totals from bags and the bank, with session gains and losses.
- Per-item visibility controls for reagent plugins.
- A single archaeology-fragments plugin on Retail and Mists of Pandaria Classic.
- Expansion-aware loading, so each game client loads only the profession and reagent data it supports.

## Supported game versions

| Game client | Profession plugins | Reagent sets | Additional plugins |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Retail / Midnight | All current professions | Legion, Battle for Azeroth, Shadowlands, and Midnight | Master and Archaeology Fragments |
| Mists of Pandaria Classic | All professions, including First Aid and Archaeology | Mists of Pandaria | Master and Archaeology Fragments |
| Classic Era | All available professions, including First Aid | Classic Era | Master |
| WoW: Forever (Camelot, interface 16001) | Classic professions, including First Aid | Classic base with Forever additions | Master |
| The Burning Crusade Classic | All available professions, including First Aid and Jewelcrafting | The Burning Crusade | Master |

First Aid is intentionally unavailable on Retail. Jewelcrafting is loaded for The Burning Crusade Classic but not for Classic Era.

Forever uses `TitanProfessionsMulti_Camelot.toc` and the modern profession API, with First Aid in its client-specific slot and a profession cap of 300. It does not load Archaeology or later-expansion reagent sets. Install a Forever-compatible version of Titan Panel alongside this addon. In-game validation on Forever is still required; local checks cannot verify protected clicks or bank behavior in the client.

Classic and Forever share `Reagents/ClassicData.lua`. Separate `Classic.lua` and `Forever.lua` entry points register the appropriate catalogue, so Forever additions never appear on Classic Era. Forever adds 31 materials across the existing six reagent plugins, including scarce materials, endgame herbs, herb seeds, new metals and bars, leather, dyes, and fishing ingredients. Plugin IDs and existing per-item settings are preserved. See [Forever reagent research](https://github.com/Canettieri/professionsmulti/blob/master/docs/forever-reagents.md) for item IDs, sources, and scope.

## How to use

1. Right-click the Titan Panel.
2. Open the **Profession** category to enable profession, Master, or archaeology plugins.
3. Open **Profession [Reagents]** to enable reagent plugins. Category names are translated for supported locales.
4. Right-click an enabled plugin to configure its display options.

Profession plugins can display the icon, maximum skill, simplified bonuses, profession combinations, and session gains. Reagent plugins can display session changes and let you hide individual reagent types. Every plugin menu also includes controls for moving the plugin left or right on its current Titan bar.

For easier identification in the Titan menu, profession plugins are yellow, reagent plugins are orange, and the Master plugin remains red.

## Archaeology Fragments

Add the **Archaeology Fragments** plugin to the Titan bar to track fragments by race. When an artifact is ready to solve, the plugin displays the corresponding race as ready. Its right-click menu can also show races that do not currently have enough fragments.

This plugin is available on Retail and Mists of Pandaria Classic.

## Languages

The addon currently includes translations for:

- English
- Brazilian Portuguese
- German
- Spanish (Spain)
- Spanish (Latin America)
- French
- Italian
- Korean
- Russian

Unsupported locales fall back to English. Reagent item names are obtained directly from the WoW client whenever available.

## Support

Please report problems through the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/Canettieri/professionsmulti/issues). When reporting an issue, include the WoW game version, character locale, and any error message shown by the client.

## Donations

If you would like to support continued development, you can [donate through PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&business=7AEAZ7XG7WVDS&lc=US&item_name=Titan%20Multi%20Addons&currency_code=USD&bn=PP-DonationsBF%3abtn_donate_SM.gif%3aNonHosted).

releases.notes:
## [11.3.0] - 2026-11-23

### Added

- Added **Hide Absent Reagents** and **Show Only Reagents in Bags** to each reagent plugin, with translations for all supported languages. Tooltips still show bag and bank counts.

### Fixed

- Fixed **Display on Right Side** for profession, reagent, and Master plugins using Titan Panel's built-in side switch.

## [11.1.0] - 2026-11-03

### Changed

- Label reagent subtotals by quality and clarify that they include bags and bank.
- Reduce the space above the first reagent while keeping a blank line between reagents.

### Fixed

- Count Retail reagents directly from equipped bags, including the reagent bag, before calculating the bank balance.
- Show the quality rank when a reagent variant's item link is still loading.

## [11.0.0] - 2026-11-01

### Added

- Added a dedicated Forever (Camelot, interface 16001) manifest with Classic professions, First Aid, Classic reagents, and Master.
- Added 31 Forever-specific materials across the six reagent plugins, with translated Forever menu labels.
- Added **Move Left** and **Move Right** controls to every plugin menu.
- Added translations for the new bar-position controls in all supported languages.

### Changed

- Updated the Retail interface version to 120105 for WoW 12.1.5.
- Adapted Forever's First Aid slot and 300-point profession cap to the shared tracker.
- Split Classic reagent data from client registration, keeping a shared baseline and a separate Forever additions file without changing existing plugin IDs or item settings.
- Use the modern spellbook API for profession and Master clicks when available, and skip profession casts during combat.
- Prefer modern C_Item APIs for reagent counts and item information, with legacy fallbacks.
- Added consistent spacing between the Bar Text, Tooltip, and Bar Position sections.
- Centralized the shared menu title, bar-position, Hide, and Close controls for consistent behavior across Retail, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Classic Era, and The Burning Crusade Classic.

# Titan Professions Multi 10.0.0

## Added

- Added profession reagent trackers for Midnight on Retail.
- Added reagent trackers for Mists of Pandaria Classic, Classic Era, and The Burning Crusade Classic.
- Added a dedicated Titan Panel category for reagent plugins: **Profession [Reagents]**.
- Added complete missing translations for German, Spanish (Spain and Latin America), French, Italian, Korean, and Russian.

## Changed

- Rebuilt all profession plugins around a shared, data-driven profession tracker while preserving their existing Titan plugin IDs and features.
- Rebuilt all reagent plugins around a shared reagent tracker with bag and bank totals, per-item visibility controls, and session gains and losses.
- Consolidated profession definitions into one file per client family instead of one file per profession.
- Consolidated reagent definitions into the new `Reagents` folder, with one file per expansion.
- Limited each reagent set to its appropriate game client: Retail, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Classic Era, or The Burning Crusade Classic.
- Integrated First Aid into the shared profession system for Mists of Pandaria Classic, Classic Era, and The Burning Crusade Classic while keeping it disabled on Retail.
- Kept Jewelcrafting exclusive to The Burning Crusade in the Vanilla/TBC profession set.
- Standardized plugin menus so the separator, Hide command, and Close command appear together at the bottom.
- Restored colored profession names in the Titan menu after Titan's sorting process.
- Standardized profession plugin names in yellow and reagent plugin names in orange, while preserving the Master plugin in red.
- Removed obsolete reagent localization entries; reagent item names now come from the WoW client whenever available.

## Fixed

- Preserved profession session gains, skill bonuses, maximum-skill warnings, tooltips, and click-to-open behavior after the shared-engine migration.
- Improved profession cap handling across Retail and Mists of Pandaria Classic, including Midnight values.
- Improved reagent updates when entering the world or changing bag and bank contents.
- Added isolated error handling so a faulty reagent definition cannot stop the remaining reagent plugins from loading or updating.
- Updated `LibAddonCompat` to version 1.1.0 (LibStub revision 13):
  - Fixed the Brazilian Portuguese name for Jewelcrafting.
  - Added safe handling for missing API functions and optional numeric values.
  - Added a fallback for Classic clients that do not reliably mark primary professions as abandonable.
  - Improved localized profession detection.

## Compatibility

- Retail / Midnight
- Mists of Pandaria Classic
- Classic Era
- The Burning Crusade Classic
